title: An underwater adventure joins the showcase
summary:
An underwater text adventure joined the showcase, while the website shed some background images.

Abyss Ascending, @brain.diver’s web-based generative text adventure set in a sci-fi underwater world, was added to the README and creative-app showcase.

The community, team, and supporter sections now use solid-color backgrounds instead of images. Their gradients remain, and eight unused image assets were removed.
